items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: one of my favorite jobs was with Jimmy Rowles when he had a quintet. And at this time he was very much into Wayne Shorter’s music.

ctx.x: And you played with Buddy DeFranco?

Yes I did. Well I did an album with him, I didn’t work with him in clubs or concerts or anything, but I was called to do an album with him and that was very good personnel, it was Jimmy Rowles was on that, that’s one of my favorite piano players, and Barney Kessel was on it, another favorite, and Sweets Edison was on it, and Buddy DeFranco and myself. And I don’t think I can remember who the bass player was right now, somebody formidable though. That was fun. I enjoyed doing that. I didn’t get a lot of chance to…
Yeah, there’s some challenging music there too, from a soloing standpoint.
